title: 44. Remove Nth Node From End Of List

examples.explanation: The 2nd node from the end of [1,2,3,4,5] is 4, so removing it yields [1,2,3,5].
The 1st node from the end of [1] is the only node, so removing it yields [].
The 1st node from the end of [1,2] is 2, so removing it yields [1].
